newsitem.title: NORWAY: Indian seaman washed overboard, missing off Norway.
newsitem.headline: Indian seaman washed overboard, missing off Norway.

text.p: An Indian seaman was missing, assumed drowned, and two others were injured on Sunday in heavy seas off the coast of northern Norway, the NTB news agency said.

The three seamen were repairing a hatch on the fore deck of the Indian bulk ore carrier Maratha Mission in the Norwegian Sea 30 miles from the island of Vega, when one of them was washed overboard and two were injured.
The ship and a Sea King helicopter from the Norwegian rescue service searched for two hours for the missing crew member but found no trace of him, NTB said.
The two injured crewmen were flown to hospital in Trondheim with head and back injuries.

"We assume that the man is dead. He was wearing only light clothes and did not have a survival suit on," NTB quoted Kjell Johansen, search leader at the main rescue centre for northern Norway, as saying.
The Maratha Mission left Narvik two days ago for Okselosund in Sweden.
